snippet.title: Where is the coffin? | GraveDiggers, Co-op Horror with Cats
snippet.description:
Where is the coffin? Nobody knows, and we need one more gravedigger to find it.

GraveDiggers is an online co-op horror game for 1 to 6 players. You play undertaker cats: grab a shovel, bring your friends, explore a cursed land, fight what lives in the mist and bury the dead before midnight.

Wishlist and free playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4383310/GraveDiggers/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=adtest_nov26&utm_content=c
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/6gWfe4epyr

#GraveDiggersGame #coopgame #horrorgaming #indiegame #WhereIsTheCoffin
